confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer anchors come from search-result summaries of aggregated price indexes (Numbeo, Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere and similar sites). These are crowd-sourced and partly undated, and I did not read full pages. PLN prices were converted at roughly 3.65 PLN per USD from general knowledge, not a looked-up rate. Cocktail uses bar-menu and guide ranges (roughly 25-58 PLN). Wine by the glass had little direct data (one chain menu showed 21-32 PLN per glass), so it is set at about 1.6x the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic peak-season (July) estimates from general knowledge. No accommodation prices were searched and no live listings were inspected, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Gdansk's own aggregated price-index figures. Accommodation is benchmarked holistically against other popular Polish summer-tourism cities such as Krakow and Warsaw, with a July peak-season uplift for Gdansk's Baltic seaside demand.
